projects.title: Sterile Processing Project
projects.description:
Recommended a new System that can better manage surgical sets used in Surgery. 
•	Created process flow charts to analyze life cycle of surgical instruments. 
•	Used quality tools to analyze root cause for systems failure
•	Created a new system that can track surgical instruments throughout its whole life cycle.
•	Created quality procedures to ensure that all surgical instruments are prepped for operations.
•	Used Simulation modeling(Promodel) to study effects on staffing and estimation of cycle time    and lead time for sterilization.
